description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Ovika and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Ovika trigger, creating a 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature token.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Phyrexian Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
